**Regulation to analyze:** SDWA sec. 1433 Risk & Resilience Assessment, 42 U.S.C. 300i-2
**Why:** The only binding federal requirement explicitly covering water-system cybersecurity; the RRA's required elements (incl. automated systems security) provide the gap-analysis scope. Use EPA's Water Cybersecurity Assessment Tool / CISA CPGs for control-level detail since statute is not prescriptive.
